connectFailure.token_malformed: The token is missing, too long, or has spaces, line breaks or text that is not part of it. Copy it again: only the token.
connectFailure.token_rejected: Meta refused the token: it is not valid, it expired or it was revoked. Generate a new one and paste it again.
connectFailure.permission_missing: The token lacks a permission. Check that it includes the permissions the channel needs and that you have the required task on the account, then generate it again.
connectFailure.request_rejected: Meta refused the request. Often the token is not the kind the channel needs, or a permission is missing. Generate the token the channel asks for (for Messenger and Instagram, the token of the Page) and try again.
connectFailure.account_not_linked: The token does not reach any professional Instagram account. Check that the account is linked to the Page and that the token is that Page's.
connectFailure.other_account: The token belongs to another account or Page than the connected one. Use the token of the same one.
connectFailure.provider_answer_unexpected: Meta answered something unexpected. Try again; if it persists, generate the token again.
connectFailure.subscription_not_confirmed: Meta did not confirm the subscription to messages. Check that the token has messaging permissions and that messaging is turned on for the app in its Meta dashboard.
connectFailure.provider_busy: Meta asks to wait. Try again in a few minutes.
connectFailure.provider_unavailable: Meta did not answer in time or answered badly. Try again in a few minutes.
connectFailure.account_unreadable: The Instagram account of the Page could not be read: check that the token is the Page's and that the account is still linked.
connectFailure.subscription_failed: The Page could not be subscribed to messages: try again; if it repeats, check the permissions of the app.
connectFailure.subscription_unreadable: The subscription of the Page to messages could not be checked. Try again in a few minutes.
connectFailure.no_assets: Facebook did not show any Page you can connect. Check that you have access to the Page, try again and tick it in the Facebook dialog; if it does not appear, type its ID number.
connectFailure.page_without_instagram: This Page has no linked Instagram account. Link one in the Page settings or choose another Page.
connectFailure.oauth_cancelled: You cancelled the access with Facebook, so nothing was connected. You can try again whenever you like.
connectFailure.oauth_expired: The access with Facebook could not be completed: it took too long, was already used or the answer was not valid. Start again.
